citation_scope_contract.root_comparison: Evidence must match root metric, both explicit periods, and every root filter exactly.
citation_scope_contract.root_breakdown: Evidence must match root metric, both explicit periods, every root filter, and the requested dimension. A narrower drill-down scope cannot discharge a root obligation by itself.
citation_scope_contract.unresolved: No numeric finding may be accepted before the required semantic clarification.
citation_scope_contract.causal: Descriptive comparison evidence does not support a causal explanation.

action_sequence_policy.semantics: Reference plans illustrate one valid path only. Any tool order that satisfies the root obligations, scope, and evidence requirements is acceptable; exact tool-sequence matching is not an acceptance criterion.

scenarios.required_revision: False: South declines by 250 while North declines by 150; South is largest by absolute change.

scenarios.summary: Offsetting groups net to zero; net contribution percentage is unavailable, not infinite or fabricated.
additional_forbidden_claims: finite net contribution percentage with zero overall delta

oracle.source: Manual addition from four static fixture rows; no production analytics used.
oracle.derivation: Jan=100+50=150; Feb=50+100=150; net delta=0. North/A each change -50; South/B each change +50. Group delta divided by total delta is undefined because denominator=0.

scenarios.summary: Negative baseline supports absolute change, but relative growth is unavailable by the frozen policy.
scenarios.relative_growth_reason: baseline is negative; do not report the arithmetic quotient as growth

oracle.source: Direct subtraction of two static fixture values; no production analytics used.
oracle.derivation: Previous=-20; current=-10; absolute delta=-10-(-20)=+10. Relative growth is unavailable because the baseline is nonpositive (even though the raw quotient would be -50%).

scenarios.summary: No current-period rows with confirmed coverage means known zero, not unknown.
scenarios.no_row_semantics: confirmed coverage makes current period zero

oracle.source: One static January row plus confirmed Jan–Mar coverage; no production analytics used.
oracle.derivation: Previous=25 from the sole January row. No February rows and full coverage is confirmed, so current=0; delta=0-25=-25; growth=-25/25=-100%.

scenarios.summary: No rows in requested periods under unknown coverage cannot be labeled zero.

oracle.source: Manual date inspection of the lone 2025-12-15 row; no production analytics used.
oracle.derivation: No fixture row falls in Jan or Feb 2026, but contract coverage is unconfirmed and unspecified. Therefore both period totals/delta are unknown, not zero.

scenarios.summary: Current period contains only null Revenue; report the observed prior subtotal and withhold delta/growth.
scenarios.null_semantics: one valid prior value; prior also has one null; current has one row and zero valid Revenue values

oracle.source: Manual inspection/addition of examples/null_sales.csv; no production analytics used.
oracle.derivation: Jan has observed valid subtotal 10 plus one null row; Feb has one row with null Revenue and zero valid amounts. Do not call the current all-null subtotal zero; comparison delta and growth are unavailable.

scenarios.summary: Excluded nulls leave missing amounts unknown even when observed subtotals can be compared.
scenarios.null_semantics: one missing Revenue row per period; observed sums are not complete totals

oracle.source: Manual addition of the non-null fixture cells; no production analytics used.
oracle.derivation: Observed North/A values are 100→120, observed delta +20. Each period also has one null South/B row, so full Revenue totals and full change remain unknown; do not impute the missing amount as zero.

scenarios.summary: Rows exist but coverage is not confirmed through the end of the current period; only observed subtotals are reportable.
scenarios.coverage_limitation: contract ends at 2026-02-15 and coverage_confirmed=false; the Feb request period ends 2026-03-01

oracle.source: Manual row sums from examples/evaluation/fixtures/incomplete_coverage.csv, labeled observed only; no production analytics used.
oracle.derivation: Included Jan rows sum to 1000. Included Feb 5 and Feb 10 rows sum to 150; delta of these observed subtotals is 150-1000=-850. Contract coverage ends 2026-02-15 and is unconfirmed, so February's subtotal and the change cannot be presented as complete-period values.
numeric_claims_allowed: observed subtotals/delta with explicit incomplete-coverage label
